documents.title: Certificate under SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Akiko Global Services Limited held its Q1 FY27 earnings conference call, reporting healthy revenue and profitability growth driven by core business expansion and branch performance. Management highlighted the near-complete development and rollout of their digital platform, AkikoPay, on Android and iOS app stores, which will integrate insurance and mutual funds next quarter. The company revised its FY27 revenue guidance upwards to INR325 crore to INR350 crore, supported by strong credit and loan disbursement momentum. Furthermore, management reaffirmed its focus on maintaining profitability and long-term hybrid distribution strength without relying on heavy marketing spends. Akiko Global Services Limited released its investor presentation for Q1 FY2026-27, highlighting strong growth in revenue, profitability, and operational scale across its credit card sourcing and loan distribution businesses.

guidance.claim: Management revised its FY27 revenue guidance to INR325 crore to INR350 crore.
guidance.quote: Earlier, I had given a target of INR300 crores. Now I am revising this guidance. I am very comfortable to get INR325 crores to INR350 crores this FY27.

guidance.claim: The company expects PAT margins of 9% to 11% for the current year.
guidance.quote: Sir, I am confident of 9% to 11% for this year.

guidance.claim: Management targets a CAGR of 70% to 100% year-on-year for the next three years.
guidance.quote: Because my vision is very clear for the next 3 years that our CAGR will remain the same at 70% to 100% year-on-year basis.

guidance.claim: Management remains confident of achieving its FY27 revenue guidance of ₹300-325 crore with healthy profitability.
guidance.quote: Management remains confident of achieving its FY27 revenue guidance of ₹300–325 crore with healthy profitability, supported by continued operational execution, growing contribution from digital initiatives, and the evolution of Akiko into a scalable consumer fintech platform.

guidance.claim: Management expects FY27 revenue growth of 70% to 100% with a target of approximately INR300 crores.
guidance.quote: I would like to give an outlook for FY27, which approximately I am expecting a target of 70% to 100% revenue growth, we have taken a minimum.

guidance.claim: Profit margins are expected to remain with similar profitability or between 9% to 11%.
guidance.quote: And profit margins will also remain with similar profitability.

guidance.claim: Management targets a long-term vision of INR1,000 crores revenue by 2030 and PAT margins of 12% to 13%.
guidance.quote: We have a proper clear vision that we build INR1,000 crores revenue by 2030 and take PAT margins further to 12% to 13%.

guidance.claim: AkikoPay revenue is expected to reach around INR50 crores in FY27.
guidance.quote: In FY27, I am expecting around INR50 crores revenue from AkikoPay.

guidance.claim: Dubai business revenue is expected to be INR20 crores in FY27.
The unsecured book is targeted to reach INR1,000 crores by March 31st.
guidance.quote: By FY27, my target is INR1,000 crores of unsecured book.

demand_outlook.claim: Bank partnerships are strong and the sourcing pipeline is healthy, providing good visibility for upcoming quarters.
demand_outlook.quote: Bank partnerships are strong, and the sourcing pipeline is healthy, due to which we see good visibility for the upcoming quarters as well.

demand_outlook.claim: Personal loans are currently growing the fastest among all loan products.
Monthly loan disbursals increased to over ₹450 crore.
demand_outlook.quote: Operational execution remained strong during the quarter, with monthly loan disbursals increasing to over ₹450 crore, while monthly credit card sourcing scaled to 17,000–18,000 cards, driven by the Company's expanding distribution capabilities, technology-enabled customer acquisition platform, and deep banking and NBFC partnerships.

demand_outlook.claim: Initial response to AkikoPay has been very encouraging with 50,000+ Android downloads and healthy user engagement trends.
demand_outlook.quote: The initial response to AkikoPay has been very encouraging. So far, we have done some 50,000+ Android downloads, and we have negligible cost on that. And user engagement trends are also very healthy.

demand_outlook.claim: Dubai operations revenue has started reviving again from April onwards after facing temporary margin pressure.
demand_outlook.quote: And, it has started reviving again from April onwards.

demand_outlook.claim: In the credit card segment, the company successfully disburses 16,000+ credit cards on a month-on-month basis.
demand_outlook.quote: If we talk about the credit card segment, which used to be our core business at one time, today we successfully disburse 16,000+ credit cards on a month-on-month basis.

demand_outlook.claim: The loan business has reached a monthly disbursement run rate of INR400 crores plus, representing an annual book of INR5,000 crores.
demand_outlook.quote: Currently, we have reached a monthly disbursement run rate of INR400 crores+, which if we count annually, our book has become INR5,000 crores as of today.

capex_expansion.claim: The company added several new branches this year including in Kolkata, UP, and Hyderabad, with plans for 25 branches in total.
capex_expansion.quote: This year we have added several branches. This year we recently added a Kolkata branch, two branches in UP, one more branch in Hyderabad, and currently these are the ones. Over the next 2-3 months, a couple of more branches are lined up, with one opening in Indore and one towards Kerala.

capex_expansion.claim: All company branches are on rent or lease and none are owned.
capex_expansion.quote: All are on rent/lease. None are owned.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has expanded its company-owned branch presence in multiple cities including Delhi NCR, Mumbai, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Ahmedabad, Pune, Jaipur, Chandigarh, Lucknow, Kolkata, Patna, and emerging markets.
capex_expansion.quote: Along with this, we have also expanded our company-owned branch presence in multiple cities. Like Delhi NCR is known to everyone, Mumbai, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Ahmedabad, Pune, Jaipur, Chandigarh, Lucknow, Kolkata, Patna, and many emerging markets.

capex_expansion.claim: Total company-owned branches across India have increased to 16.
capex_expansion.quote: I mean, where we had three or four branches in the last quarter, today we have 16 branches across India.

capex_expansion.claim: Total combined workforce, including employees and channel partners, has crossed 900 plus.
capex_expansion.quote: Reflecting this scale-up, our total combined workforce, including employees and channel partners, has now crossed 900+, which is a very strong growth compared to last year.

margins_costs.claim: Unsecured loan disbursements yield an average payout of 3.10%.
margins_costs.quote: In unsecured, our average payout itself is 3.10%.

margins_costs.claim: Customer acquisition for AkikoPay will be done at a negligible cost using employees and the existing database.
margins_costs.quote: We will acquire customers at a negligible cost using only our employees and existing database.

margins_costs.claim: The company delivered robust revenue growth while maintaining healthy profitability.
margins_costs.quote: The Company delivered robust revenue growth while maintaining healthy profitability, supported by sustained momentum across its credit card sourcing and lending businesses, reflecting the resilience of its diversified business model.

margins_costs.claim: Q4 revenue from operations was INR57.7 crores, representing a 48% year-on-year growth, with EBITDA of INR7.9 crores and PAT growing by approximately 30%.
margins_costs.quote: In Q4, our revenue from operations has been INR57.7 crores, which is a 48% year-on-year growth. And EBITDA is INR7.9 crores. And PAT approximately has grown by 30%.

margins_costs.claim: FY26 revenue reached INR172.6 crores against a vision of INR150 crores, with a PAT margin of 10.3%.
margins_costs.quote: If I tell you now that last year I had committed to everyone that we had given a vision of INR150 crores, against that we booked revenue of INR172.6 crores. I had given a vision that 9% to 11% PAT could be maintained, that we did of 10.3%.

orders_capacity.claim: The company currently operates 25 branches across 19 cities in India.
orders_capacity.quote: So, we have 25 branches across 19 cities in India.

orders_capacity.claim: Management targets employee count to reach 1,400 to 1,500 and monthly loan disbursements to reach INR1,000 crores by December end.
orders_capacity.quote: Sir, our vision is that in this quarter, our employee count should reach 1,400 to 1,500, plus by December end, we will reach around INR1,000 crores disbursement.

capital_allocation.claim: There are no plans for fundraising for the next 6 months to 1 year as internal accruals and bank support are sufficient.
capital_allocation.quote: No, sir. There is absolutely no plan for fundraising right now. Even banks are supporting us very well. So, our CC limits are well aligned. So, no need for any fundraising for the next 6 months or 1 year. That means there is no plan until then.

capital_allocation.claim: Unsecured loans constitute 80% of the book, while secured loans account for 20%.
capital_allocation.quote: In secured, we are doing only 20% of business. In unsecured, we are doing 80% of business in our book.

risks_headwinds.claim: Dubai business revenue faced pressure and was lower due to war conditions in the first quarter.
risks_headwinds.quote: In Dubai, due to war, our total revenue for the entire quarter was INR1.25 crores.

risks_headwinds.claim: Receivable days are currently coming down from 133 days to 110 days.
risks_headwinds.quote: From 133 days, receivable days are coming down to 110 days.

risks_headwinds.claim: Dubai operations experienced temporary margin pressure due to geopolitical issues around the Iran region.
risks_headwinds.quote: And some of our margin pressure has come in Dubai operations, there has been temporary margin pressure due to the current geopolitical situation, as you all know, around the Iran region.

management_commitments.claim: The new version of the AkikoPay app will be implemented on Apple's App Store within a week.
management_commitments.quote: Customers are also really liking our new Android version and this same version will be implemented on Apple's App Store within a week.

management_commitments.claim: Integration of insurance and mutual funds into AkikoPay will begin after the upcoming App Store update and take about 2 months.
management_commitments.quote: After that version, our integration of insurance and mutual funds will begin. That will take 2 months.

management_commitments.claim: Receivable days are expected to come down to within 90 days in Q2.
management_commitments.quote: In Q2, I see receivable days coming down to within 90 days.

management_commitments.claim: Management will achieve the INR300 crore to INR325 crore guidance given for FY27.
management_commitments.quote: When I gave you guidance for FY27 of INR300 crore to INR325 crore, I am very confident we will achieve that number for sure.

management_commitments.claim: The iOS version of AkikoPay is progressing as planned and is expected to offer a comprehensive experience in the coming months.
management_commitments.quote: The iOS version is progressing as planned and is expected to offer a similar comprehensive experience in the coming months.

management_commitments.claim: Management remains confident of achieving its FY27 revenue guidance of ₹300–325 crore with healthy profitability.
management_commitments.quote: Management remains confident of achieving its FY27 revenue guidance of ₹300–325 crore with healthy profitability, supported by continued operational execution, growing contribution from digital initiatives, and the evolution of Akiko into a scalable consumer fintech platform.

management_commitments.claim: AkikoPay will be live on iOS with all features within the current month.
management_commitments.quote: So most likely within this month, AkikoPay will be live on iOS with all features.

management_commitments.claim: Ankur Gaba will take the MD or CEO position in the next quarter.
management_commitments.quote: So, we'll take a -- we'll take a decision very soon and in the next quarter, you will see me as an MD.

management_commitments.claim: Mutual fund and insurance products are expected to go live by August onwards.
management_commitments.quote: So mutual fund and insurance going to be live by August onwards because for that I have applied for some IRDAI license.

management_commitments.claim: The company targets reaching 5 lakh customers on AkikoPay by September 30th.
management_commitments.quote: so I am expecting 5 lakh customers by 30th of September and 1 million customers till 31st December.

management_commitments.claim: The company targets reaching 1 million customers on AkikoPay by December 31st.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
